title: WAM-TTT: Steering World-Action Models by Watching Human Play at Test Time
abstract: arXiv:2607.06988v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Steering robot foundation models (RFMs) toward new task variants or user-preferred behaviors remains challenging, often requiring additional robot demonstrations, task-specific fine-tuning, or long-context conditioning. We present WAM-TTT, a test-time training framework for steering world action models from raw human videos. Rather than treating human videos as trajectories to imitate, WAM-TTT absorbs them into a lightweight adaptive memory inside a frozen WAM through self-supervised video prediction. To make this memory useful for control, we introduce a meta-training stage that aligns human demonstrations with robot behaviors using paired human-robot data and a key--value memory reconstruction objective. At test time, only unlabeled human videos are required to adapt the memory, while the pretrained WAM remains frozen. This enables efficient and reusable steering without robot actions, human-side annotations, or task-specific

translated_title: WAM-TTT：通过在测试时观看人类玩耍来引导世界-动作模型
translated_abstract: 引导机器人基础模型（RFMs）适应新的任务变体或用户偏好的行为仍然具有挑战性，通常需要额外的机器人演示、任务特定的微调或长上下文条件化。我们提出了WAM-TTT，这是一个从原始人类视频出发对世界动作模型进行引导的测试时训练框架。WAM-TTT并不将人类视频视为需要模仿的轨迹，而是通过自监督视频预测将其吸收到冻结的WAM内部的轻量级自适应记忆中。为了使这种记忆对控制有用，我们引入了一个元训练阶段，利用成对的人-机器人数据和键值记忆重建目标，将人类演示与机器人行为对齐。在测试时，仅需无标注的人类视频即可对记忆进行适配，而预训练的WAM保持冻结。这使得无需机器人动作、人类端标注或任务特定的微调，即可实现高效且可复用的行为引导。
tldr: WAM-TTT提出了一种测试时训练框架，通过元训练使冻结的世界动作模型内获得轻量级自适应记忆，在测试时仅需观看无标注的人类视频即可高效引导机器人行为，无需机器人演示、人类标注或任务特定微调。
en_tdlr: WAM-TTT is a test-time training framework that equips a frozen world-action model with a lightweight adaptive memory via meta-training, enabling efficient steering of robot behaviors at test time by watching only unlabeled human videos, without robot demonstrations, human annotations, or task-specific fine-tuning.
